changes: Ported the B-9dfb DONE readiness behavior into current main by tightening done_prepare dirty metadata handling to same-story lifecycle metadata, adding an other-story metadata blocker smoke, and updating the DONE prepare decision document.
usage: Hosts continue using lattice done_prepare --storyId=<story> --mergeMain --refreshStale --validate and lattice lifecycle_check --target=DONE; metadata-only same-story lifecycle dirt is handled without cleanTree deadlock.
expectedOutcome: Running done_prepare with unchanged same-story lifecycle metadata dirt should continue and print DONE prepare: PASS in the covered smoke, while dirty source, unsafe renames, other-story metadata, and failed DONE-required evidence still block.
actualTranscript: live_smoke_transcript captured node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-smoke.js exitCode 0; output included pre-existing DONE-required lifecycle metadata does not block preflight or final PASS, other-story lifecycle metadata still blocks preflight, failed DONE-required lifecycle metadata blocks DONE closure, and done-prepare smoke passed.
outcomeDiff: No difference: actual transcript matched the expected PASS/blocker split.
limitations: Local readiness only; this story does not claim Authority DONE, fullAuthorityDone, productionDone, or solve true storyFilesHash/material drift.
pitfalls: B-9dfb existed on orchestrate/main but not local main, so the safe path was a fresh story and semantic port. Initial verificationEvidence went stale after the implementation commit and required evidence_refresh --apply before validate passed.
